nodes.name: Shield
nodes.desc: Frontline blocker. High HP, holds zombies and draws them onto himself.

nodes.name: Shotgunner
nodes.desc: Close defence. Wide spread of pellets that knock zombies back.

nodes.name: Flamethrower
nodes.desc: Close crowd control. Sets zombies on fire.

nodes.name: Machine gunner
nodes.desc: Crowd shredder. Very high fire rate, short range.

nodes.name: Marksman
nodes.desc: Mid-range precision. Fills the gap between Rifleman and Sniper.

nodes.name: Sniper
nodes.desc: Long-range picker. Bullets pierce; picks targets by the priority you set.

nodes.name: Sniper: pierce +2
nodes.desc: Each bullet goes through two more zombies.

nodes.name: Grenadier
nodes.desc: Light indirect fire. Throws grenades over walls.

nodes.name: Bazooka
nodes.desc: Splash damage. Rockets burst on impact.

nodes.name: Mortar
nodes.desc: Indirect fire over buildings. Drag the handle to where the shells land.

nodes.name: Medic
nodes.desc: Support. Heals soldiers out in the street around him.

nodes.name: Engineer
nodes.desc: Support. Repairs roadblocks near him and makes them tougher.

nodes.name: Sentry operator
nodes.desc: Deploys a turret anywhere that keeps the cone he had.

nodes.name: Cement barrier
nodes.desc: Very strong, very limited, and never moves once placed.

nodes.name: Plastic barrier
nodes.desc: A light roadblock. Zombies go round it if they can.

nodes.name: Sandbag nest
nodes.desc: Cover: the soldier in it takes half damage.
